Anyroute is building an open inference routing layer for AI applications on Robinhood Chain. Developers use one OpenRouter-compatible API to access models and providers, set routing preferences around cost, latency, privacy, and availability, and manage usage through a unified USDG balance. Each generation is designed to produce a signed receipt with the model, provider, tokens, route, and cost, making AI inference more programmable, accountable, and easier to integrate into agent workflows.
